question: Which of the following statements regarding tobacco is FALSE ?:

options.opa: The main cause of death related to tobacco are malignant neoplasms.
options.opb: On average, one in three smokers will die prematurely as a result of smoking.
options.opc: Tobacco increases the risk of bladder cancer.
options.opd: Those who stop smoking have a lung cancer mortality rate almost 50% lower at 10 years than subjects who continue smoking.
